annotations.title: US tariff (HTS) code lookup with duty rates

description: US tariff (HTS) code lookup with duty rates — Look up the U.S. Harmonized Tariff Schedule by code or keyword (USITC, public domain): every matching tariff line with its full description path (heading > subheading > line), general (MFN) duty rate, special/preferential rates (USMCA, KORUS...), column 2 rate, units, footnotes, rates inherited down to 10-digit statistical suffixes, and any Chapter 99 lines that reference the code (Section 301/232-style extra duties). Params: q (required: an HTS code such as 0901.21 or 8471300100, or a product keyword), limit (optional, default 25, max 50). For plain-English product descriptions use /v1/ai/hts-classify. Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: trade_hts_lookup
